VSCode-style vertical icon rail (`nav`): 44px items with icon/label/badge/active indicator, tooltip labels and `slot="end"` bottom pinning. Exports: `ActivityRail`, `ActivityRailItem`. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add wmzy/haze-ui/activity-rail ``` The wrapper lands at `components/ui/haze/activity-rail.tsx` (via the `@ui/` target placeholder from `components.json`) and re-exports the component(s) from the `haze-ui` npm package, which is installed automatically. ## Theming haze-ui ships JS and CSS separately — the installed wrapper already imports `haze-ui/css/tokens.css` and `haze-ui/css/activity-rail.css`, so no extra stylesheet setup is needed. Activate the design tokens by applying the classes to a root element: ```jsx import { lightTheme, spacing, typography } from 'haze-ui'; // on or any root container — darkTheme is a drop-in swap
…
``` Details: https://github.com/wmzy/haze-ui/tree/main/registry
